location_qualifier: assembly area well south of Saint-Lô
source_locator: R603: p. 60; R280: Einsatz und Unterstellung (to 6 July 1944)
current_activity: 2nd SS Panzer Division assembling well south of Saint-Lô in the Seventh Army reserve, ready to move to La Haye-du-Puits
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 4 p. 60 (the German defenses on 3 July, the first day of the VIII Corps attack): "The 2d SS Panzer Division, assembling well south of St. Lô in Seventh Army reserve, was able to move, if needed, to meet a serious threat near la Haye-du-Puits"; the Lexikon der Wehrmacht page has the division, apart from the Kampfgruppe Weidinger, still gathering in the Saint-Lô area and completing its training. Location: the assembly area south of Saint-Lô; the point is Saint-Lô with a precision of 25 km, because the sources say well south of the city without naming a village. Location approximate: no village is named; the point is the city north of the area. Location support: good: two source families (the CMH and the Lexikon) agree on the Saint-Lô area. Relationship: the Seventh Army reserve, from Breakout and Pursuit ch. 4 p. 60; the end is the day before the 6 July row.

source_locator: R280: Einsatz und Unterstellung (6 July 1944 entry)
current_activity: 2nd SS Panzer Division headquarters takes over its own front sector northeast of Périers
notes: Event date: Lexikon der Wehrmacht, 2. SS-Panzer-Division page: the division command "übernahm außerdem am 6. Juli 1944 einen eigenen Frontabschnitt nordöstlich Periers", and withdrew to a line south of Périers on 27 July. Location: the sector northeast of Périers; the point is Périers, with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the point is the town, the sector lies northeast of it. Location support: moderate: one source family. Context: the division fought in Kampfgruppes under other divisions at the same time (Lexikon).

location_qualifier: isthmus end of a division strung across the Cotentin
current_activity: 2nd SS Panzer Division strung across the Cotentin, battling the VIII Corps at La Haye-du-Puits and VII Corps at Carentan
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 5 p. 89: the division "had been moved westward from the II Parachute Corps sector to meet the American attack, and by 7 July its troops were strung across the Cotentin and battling both VIII Corps at la Haye-du-Puits and VII Corps on the Carentan-Périers isthmus". Location: the Carentan-Périers isthmus end of the line; the point is Périers, with a precision of 10 km; the other end of the division was at La Haye-du-Puits. Location approximate: the division was split between two points about 25 km apart. Context: the Lexikon der Wehrmacht LXXXIV. Armee-Korps page has the division stopping a further American advance toward Saint-Lô by a counterattack on 7 July, without a place; the two rows are not alternatives.

current_activity: 2nd SS Panzer Division task force strikes the right flank of the 30th Division near le Désert; Panzer Lehr to come
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 6 p. 113: "Later in the morning on 9 July, small probing elements of a tank-infantry task force of the 2d SS Panzer Division struck the 30th Division right flank near le Désert"; the attack came from the west with an infantry battalion supported by a tank company, from the east the full power of Panzer Lehr was expected; ch. 6 p. 102 has Kluge approving the plan to send part of the division eastward across the Taute. Location: the American right flank near le Désert (the dataset place Le Dézert), with a precision of 5 km. Location support: moderate: one source, the place of the contact is named.

current_activity: 2nd SS Panzer Division, with the 6th Parachute Regiment, defending the Périers area
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 12 p. 227 gives the German order of battle on the morning of 24 July 1944, the day before the Cobra bombardment: the still-strong 2d SS Panzer Division, augmented by the separate 6th Parachute Regiment, defended in the Périers area (two infantry and two tank companies were held as an army reserve task force). Location: Périers area. Location approximate: the Green Book gives the sector, not the command post of the unit.

current_activity: 2nd SS Panzer Division overran and captured Mortain and held blocking positions half way to St. Hilaire by noon
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 24 p. 462: the attack began shortly after midnight 6/7 August; the 2d SS Panzer Division attacked in two columns, overran Mortain from both sides and captured the town; by noon of 7 August its troops held blocking positions about half way between Mortain and St. Hilaire. Location: Mortain, named as the town captured. Opponents: only elements of the 3d Armored and the 30th Infantry Divisions had been identified in the attack zone (p. 461); the 2d Battalion, 120th Infantry held Hill 317 east of Mortain and pinned the division down. Context: the division was reinforced by the 17th SS Panzer Grenadier Division, reduced to regimental strength (p. 461).

location_qualifier: division sector on the II SS Panzer Corps front opposite the US VII Corps
current_activity: 2d SS Panzer Division (about 6,000 men) holds the right wing of the sector opposite the US VII Corps
notes: Event date: CMH The Last Offensive ch. 2 p. 27: "the 12th Volks Grenadier Division opposite the left wing of the corps, the 560th Volks Grenadier Division in the center, and the 2d SS Panzer Division opposite the right wing"; p. 28: "strengths varied from 2,500 men in the 560th to 6,000 in the panzer division". Event definition: the situation on the eve of the First Army attack of 3 January. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Houffalize with a precision of 25 km, the town that was the objective of the VII Corps; the division position is given as a wing of the corps front only. Location approximate: the town of Houffalize for a division sector. Location support: CMH names the position within the II SS Panzer Corps front. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US VII Corps.
